scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env dev && wrangler dev --env dev --var BETTER_AUTH_SECRET:local-development-only-secret-never-deploy-0000
scripts.deploy:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env dev && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.build:check: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env dev --outdir dist/dev && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/production
